sloka: इमम् देशम् अनुप्राप्तौ क्षुधा आर्तस्य इह तिष्ठतः ।स बाण चाप खड्गौ च तीक्ष्ण शृंगौ इव ऋषभौ ॥३-६९-४५॥
transliteration: imam deśam anuprāptau kṣudhā ārtasya iha tiṣṭhataḥ ।sa bāṇa cāpa khaḍgau ca tīkṣṇa śṛṁgau iva ṛṣabhau ॥3-69-45॥

translations.english: Holding bows, arrows and swords, looking like bulls with pointed horns you have entered my mouth. It is impossible for you to live any more.
